intro.h2: No surprises, from tear-out to tile
paragraphs: Dynasty Home Improvement LLC does bathroom remodeling in Colchester, and its reviews keep coming back to one idea: no surprises. One reviewer said David verified the placement of railings, cabinets, fixtures and tile with them along the way, and kept the house clean the whole time.

Bathrooms here often go deeper than new tile. One first-floor bathroom needed the old tile removed and a section of subfloor replaced before the new tile, sink and toilet went in, and those homeowners planned to have David renovate their two other bathrooms next. A review highlight on Google adds that he stays within the agreed budget and timing.

about.h2: About David and Dynasty Home Improvement
about.text: Dynasty Home Improvement LLC is a bathroom remodeler based on Windham Ave in Colchester, Connecticut. Customers deal directly with David, who plans the job, leads his crew and keeps in touch from start to finish. Reviewers describe him as multi-talented, prompt and attentive to their wishes. The work covers full bathroom renovations, tile showers, subfloor repair, kitchen remodels and smaller kitchen updates like range and vent swaps. Some clients plan their next rooms with him, and the company replies to its Google reviews to thank customers for their business.
about.owner_role: Runs the jobs and the crew (named in every captured review; called Dave in one); last name not published

items.name: Brian M.
items.text: David was excellent in planning and executing the bathroom renovation and kept us informed along the way verifying placement of railings, cabinets, fixtures, and tiling to ensure no surprises and kept our house clean. He is a multi-talented professional.

items.name: Susan K.
items.text: We are very happy with David's renovation of our first floor bathroom. The job involved removal of the old tile, replacement of a section of the sub-floor, installation of new tile, and replacement of our old sink, toilet and their fixtures. All were very well done. Also, David was prompt and always attentive to our wishes. It was a pleasure to work with him. We will hire David to renovate our two other bathrooms next year and we do not hesitate recommending him for his work.

items.name: Janice
items.text: David and his crew did a smaller job for us involving replacing a downdraft range with a conventional double roven range. This included installing new above the range vent, moving and replacing old venting, and moving and adding electrical outlets. He was very accomodating to work our project in between larger ones. David is easy to work with, good at communicating, and follows  through with what was promised. His crew did a beautiful job on the sheet work and finishing steps. All are very professional and take pride in a job well done.

service_area.text: Dynasty Home Improvement LLC works from 7A Windham Ave, Colchester, CT 06415. Colchester is the town on its Google profile and the town tied to its Facebook project posts. If you are planning a bathroom remodel, a tile shower or a kitchen update in or near Colchester, call (860) 710-4602 on a weekday to check whether your home fits David's schedule.

items.q: What if my bathroom floor is damaged under the tile?
items.a: That is work David has handled. On one first-floor bathroom the crew removed the old tile, replaced a section of the subfloor, then installed new tile and replaced the sink, toilet and fixtures. If the floor feels soft or uneven, mention it when you call so it can be checked.

items.q: Will I know what is going on during the job?
items.a: Yes. A reviewer said David kept them informed along the way, verifying the placement of railings, cabinets, fixtures and tile to ensure no surprises. Other reviewers say he responds quickly to any communication and is good at communicating throughout the project.

items.q: Do you take on small jobs?
items.a: Yes. One customer had a downdraft range replaced with a conventional range, including a new vent hood, rerouted venting and moved outlets. The customer said David was very accommodating in fitting the project in between larger ones. Call and describe the job to see when it can be scheduled.

items.q: Do you remodel kitchens as well?
items.a: Yes. A Google review highlight says Dave remodeled their bathroom and their kitchen, and their photos include a white shaker kitchen with marble-look counters, a sink under the window and a herringbone backsplash. Bathrooms are the main specialty, but kitchen work is part of what they do.

Google lists Dynasty Home Improvement LLC as open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (860) 710-4602 during those hours to describe the bathroom or kitchen work you want done, and have a few photos of the room ready to share.
